description: What the workspace suite must notice: the checks of a repository address and of the clone arguments, the limits, the registry and the folder guard, the environment and the hardening flags of every Git process the Hub starts, where the token goes, what is hidden from error messages, the export exclusions and headers, the rules of a push, and the removal of a tree the agent made. Run on Linux as an ordinary user: W106 and W107 (the removal of a tree without permissions) cannot be told from the original as root, who ignores permissions; verify-e2e-public.mjs covers the same steps with the real hub and agent accounts (P37, P38).
